text: Wizard: Chocolatier

The Chocolatier is a whimsical wizard that masters different
schools of magic all for the sake of creating delicious
chocolate. The Chocolatier possesses different magic items
that allow them to mass produce chocolate.
Cooking Prodigy
2nd-level Chocolatier Magic feature

You are an academic in both the ways of magic and making
chocolate. You gain proficiency in cook’s utensils, and your
proficiency bonus is doubled for any checks made using this
item.
Cocoa Homunculus
2nd-level Chocolatier Magic feature

Your affinity with chocolate allows you to make a 

homunculus to help you make more chocolate. It is 

friendly to you and your companions, and it obeys your
commands. See this creature's game statistics in the 

Cocoa Homunculus stat block, which uses your proficiency
bonus (PB) in several places.

You determine the homunculus’ appearance, though it is
made entirely out of chocolate. Some chocolatiers prefer to
have the servant adopt a creature-like appearance, while
others make them look like baking equipment, like a sieve or
mixing bowl.

In combat, the homunculus shares your initiative count,
but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It can move and
use its reaction on its own, but the only action it takes on its
turn is the Dodge action, unless you take a bonus action on
your turn to command it to take another action. That action
can be one in its stat block or some other action. If you are
incapacitated, the homunculus can take any action of its
choice, not just Dodge.

A creature of your choice can use an action to eat the
homunculus. When it does, it regains a number of hit points
equal to 1d6 + your wizard level, and the homunculus is
reduced to 0 hit points and dies.

If the homunculus has died within the last hour, you can
use your cook’s utensils as an action to create a new one,
provided you expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher. The
new homunculus appears within 5 feet of you after 1 minute.

At the end of a long rest, you can create a new homunculus
if you have your cook’s utensils with you. If you already have a
homunculus from this feature, the first one immediately
perishes. The homunculus also perishes if you die.
Addictive Chocolate
6th-level Chocolatier Magic feature

You are able to make sweets that have people begging for
more. Once before the end of your next long rest, you can use
cook’s utensils and spend 1 hour magically making a number
of tiny chocolate up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded
up). This chocolate lasts for 24 hours, after which it will turn
bad and decay.

When a creature eats this chocolate, it must succeed on a
Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or be
charmed by you for 1 hour. While charmed in this way, the
creature immediately knows it was charmed by you. However,
as long as it can see at least one piece of chocolate made by
this feature, it will begrudgingly obey your commands in the
hopes of receiving more chocolate. After 1 hour, you can use
an action to give the same creature a piece of chocolate and
extend the charmed duration. If the creature doesn't see any
chocolate, it is no longer charmed by you and becomes
hostile toward you. Offering a piece of chocolate while the
creature is hostile in this way will not placate it.

This charmed condition ends early if the creature takes any
damage, if you attack it, or if it witnesses you attacking or
damaging any of its allies.
Tenser's Transparent Elevator
10th-level Chocolatier Magic feature

Your whimsical acts have resulted in you creating an equal
whimsical magic contraption. As an action, you conjure a
magical elevator centred on a point you can see within 60
feet of you. The elevator is an invisible 10-foot cube of
shimmering force. An unwilling creature must succeed on a
Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC or be
trapped inside the elevator.

The elevator has AC 10, 30 hit points, and immunity to all
conditions. If it is forced to make a saving throw, treat all its
ability scores as 10 (+0). On each of your subsequent turns,
you must spend an action to maintain the elevator's
existence. Also, as part of the same action, you can choose to
open or close the elevator’s doors. While the doors are closed,
objects or creatures can’t physically enter or exit the elevator.
You can also move the elevator up to 30 feet on each of your
turns (no action required).

Any creature inside the elevator is considered as being
behind total cover if the doors are closed. A creature behind
the elevator is considered behind half cover. Additionally,
creatures of your choice inside the elevator can choose to
make an attack or cast a spell targeting an area outside the
elevator, even if the elevator’s doors are closed.

The elevator lasts for 1 minute (as if you were
concentrating on a spell) or if you use your action to do
anything else. It also disappears if it is more than 120 feet
away from you, it is reduced to 0 hit points, or if it is hit with a
disintegrate spell. Once you conjure the elevator, you can’t do
so again until you finish a long rest.
Mass Chocolate Production
14th-level Chocolatier Magic feature

You can create more chocolate helpers to aid you in your
tasks. You gain the following benefits:

Your homunculus gains a +2 bonus to AC
If the homunculus is subjected to an effect that allows it to
make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it
instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving
throw, and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait
if it's incapacitated.
You can now have two homunculi at the same time. You
can create two with the same action (but not the same
spell slot), and you can activate both of them with the
same bonus action. You determine whether the homunculi
are identical to each other or different. You can't create a
third homunculi while you have two.
